data.title: Our Physical Presence Across India
data.description: Finance Forum of India (FFOI) operates through strategically located centres across India to deliver industry-aligned finance education, assessments, and certifications. Each centre follows a standardised academic framework, central governance, and national skill alignment — ensuring consistency, credibility, and quality across locations.

data.title: Delivery Hubs, Not Independent Units
data.description: FFOI centres are designed to function as delivery and engagement hubs, not independent coaching units. Across all centres, FFOI ensures a consistent academic framework, central governance, and national skill alignment.
